name: Icebreaker
backDesc: Get to know someone for real.
preview: Icebreaker is designed for people who just met — whether through a dating app, at a party, or anywhere in between. 3 levels take you from playful first impressions to real, meaningful conversation.
No awkward silences. Just honest questions.
questions:
If your life had a theme song
 right now, what would it be?

What's the most useless
 talent you have?
 Show me.

What's the last thing that
 made you laugh until
 you cried?

What would your best friend
 say is your most annoying
 habit?

If you could only eat one
 cuisine for the rest of
 your life, what would it be?

What's your go-to
 comfort show when you've
 had a rough day?

What's the worst pickup line
 you've ever received?

If you had to describe
 yourself in three emojis,
 which ones would you pick?

What's a hobby you've
 always wanted to try
 but never have?

What's the most spontaneous
 thing you've ever done?

Do you believe in
 astrology? What's your
 sign? Do you think it
 fits you?

What's the last song you
 listened to on repeat?
 Why?

If you could live in any
 city in the world for a year,
 where would you go?

What's one thing on your
 bucket list you're determined
 to check off soon?

What's the most random
 fact you know?

Wild Card Think of your favorite
 ice cream flavor. On the count
 of three, say it out loud.
 (Both players)

Wild Card Share the last meme
 you saved on your phone.
 Explain why it's funny.

Wild Card Rate your cooking skills

 count of three, say your

Wild Card Send each other a song

Wild Card Share the last photo

 Explain the context.

Wild Card Write down 3 words that

 (Both players)

 Permission to go there.
